visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video captures a handheld recording of a large stadium jumbotron at night during a rainstorm. On the screen, a baseball player wearing a maroon Rakuten jersey is being interviewed; he smiles broadly, raises his right arm in a triumphant fist, and gestures towards the crowd with his other hand. Standing next to him is a man in a similar jersey and glasses, holding a black microphone. (2) The scene continues as the baseball player bows his head respectfully while the man beside him speaks into the microphone. The background on the screen shows other team members in jerseys moving across the field. In the actual foreground of the recording, the silhouettes of a large crowd's heads are visible, all looking upward at the bright digital display. (3) The player stands tall again, looking directly into the camera on the jumbotron with a focused and determined facial expression. The stadium's artificial lights illuminate the falling raindrops, creating a shimmering white texture against the dark night sky. Prominent commercial logos and banners for brands like MAXXIS and Persephone are visible along the base of the screen structure.
